home.lead: Eugene Kozlovsky's personal site. My projects, texts, working drafts and thoughts are collected here. I write in Ukrainian and English. I publish what I find worth attention, when I have something to say.
home.thesis: koztechie — developer who works with AI and systems architect
home.cta_note: The only way to reach me is email.

principles.title: Facts matter more than impressions
principles.text: I prefer what can be verified to what sounds good. If I don't know something or can't confirm it, I say so.

principles.title: Openness without show
principles.text: I don't try to build a flawless image. Dates, sources, context and honest corrections matter. But private life does not have to become public property.

principles.title: Contact without extra noise
principles.text: If you want to discuss something — write a letter. I don't run open comments, chats or dozens of channels.

principles.title: Nobody owes anybody publications
principles.text: I don't run this site on a schedule and don't promise to publish regularly. I may disappear for a long time and then come back to work. That needs no explanation.
